# External References

This directory tracks related repositories, pull requests, and upstream work
that lab members should know about. Use links when copying code would make
provenance or maintenance harder.

## Repositories

| Name | Link | Role in this repo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B-MCFD | https://github.com/xiaoran007/B-MCFD | Related multi-camera fall detection codebase. |
| Kinetics-i3d-for-modern-pytorch | https://github.com/xiaoran007/Kinetics-i3d-for-modern-pytorch | Modern PyTorch I3D reference implementation. |

| multi_cam_jetson PR #2 | https://github.com/C-H-Chien/multi_cam_jetson/pull/2 | Upstream PR related to multi-camera Jetson work. |

## Link Record Convention

When adding a new external reference, include:

- Stable URL.
- Short description.
- Why lab members may need it.
- Whether the link is source, upstream issue/PR, paper, data, or documentation.
- Any license or access notes.
